// KILI LOADER v1 - loads the latest Kili code from Accent's GitHub. Do not edit.
var KILI_CODE_URL = 'https://bullpranav-code.github.io/instagram-automation/ila/code/Kili_v4.txt';
function load_() {
  if (globalThis.__KILI_READY) return;
  var c = CacheService.getScriptCache(), code = c.get('kili_code');
  if (!code) {
    var r = UrlFetchApp.fetch(KILI_CODE_URL + '?t=' + Date.now(), { muteHttpExceptions: true });
    if (r.getResponseCode() !== 200) throw new Error('Could not load Kili code (' + r.getResponseCode() + ')');
    code = r.getContentText();
    try { c.put('kili_code', code, 600); } catch (e) {}
  }
  (0, eval)(code);
  globalThis.__KILI_READY = true;
}
function doGet(e) { load_(); return doGet(e); }
function ccReview(f) { load_(); return ccReview(f); }
function ccFeedback(f) { load_(); return ccFeedback(f); }
function setup() { load_(); return setup(); }
function refreshCode() { CacheService.getScriptCache().remove('kili_code'); load_(); Logger.log('Kili code reloaded.'); }
